field.label: Enable Beszel Agent
field.help: Enable or disable the Beszel Agent service.

field.label: Hub URL
field.help: URL of the Beszel Hub server (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8090).

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: Port on which the agent listens for connections (default: 45876).

field.label: Public Key
field.help: SSH public key provided by the Beszel Hub when adding this system.

field.label: Token
field.help: Authentication token provided by the Beszel Hub.

field.label: Extra Filesystems
field.help: Comma-separated list of extra mount points to monitor for disk usage (e.g. /mnt/data,/mnt/backup). Optional.
